BiblicalUsage: Eluzai is an Israelite. In 1 Chronicles 12:5, the text says "Eluzai." The life behind the name is told on the Eluzai People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eluzai matters because God knows His people by name, and Eluzai is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
